app.name: HerHealth Liberia
app.tagline: Trusted health information. In your language. In your hands.
app.disclaimer: HerHealth provides health information and does not replace a qualified health professional.
common.offline: You are offline. Saved content is still available.
privacy.title: Your privacy matters
privacy.intro: HerHealth provides educational health information. You do not need to enter your name to use the service.
language.title: Choose your language
language.moreComing: More languages will appear here after fluent speakers and health reviewers have checked every translation.
home.title: What would you like to know about?
learn.title: Learn
learn.subtitle: Health topics reviewed by qualified health professionals.
learn.empty: Articles for this topic are being written and medically reviewed. Please check again soon.
article.notInLanguage: This article is not yet available in your language. Showing English.
ask.title: Ask HerHealth
ask.subtitle: Ask a private question about reproductive or maternal health.
ask.suggest2: When should I start antenatal care?
ask.notStored: Your question is not saved. HerHealth is not a doctor and cannot diagnose.
ask.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ask.fallback: I don't have enough verified information in the HerHealth knowledge library to answer that question reliably. You can search our health topics or contact a qualified health professional.
ask.amberNote: Because you mentioned a symptom, it is a good idea to talk to a qualified health professional, especially if it is severe, getting worse or not going away.
red.title: You may need urgent medical attention
red.body: What you're describing could require immediate professional care. HerHealth cannot determine the cause.
protection.title: You are not alone
protection.body: What happened is not your fault. You deserve to be safe and supported. Trained support services can help you, and you can choose what to do next.
protection.medical: If you are hurt, a health facility can give you care.
protection.privacy: HerHealth does not record what you wrote.
crisis.title: Your life matters
crisis.body: It sounds like you are going through something very painful. You do not have to face this alone. Please reach out now to someone you trust or to a health service.
crisis.action: If you are in immediate danger, go to the nearest health facility or ask someone near you to help you get there.
help.title: Find Health Services
help.empty: No verified services match your search yet.
help.noneYet: HerHealth only lists services that our team has verified directly. Verified services are being added.
emergency.title: Emergency information
emergency.body: If someone is in danger, unconscious, bleeding heavily or having trouble breathing, get them to the nearest health facility as quickly as possible.
emergency.none: No verified emergency contacts have been published yet.
menu.title: Menu
settings.clearSessionHelp: Deletes the anonymous ID on this phone and removes your feedback comments from our server.
feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.placeholder: Tell us what was difficult or what we should improve. Please do not include your name or phone number.
feedback.thanks: Thank you. Your feedback helps us improve HerHealth.
